entities.summary: Fifth Dynasty of Egypt is a dynasty based in Africa, founded in 2497 BCE and dissolved in 2344 BCE. It contributed significantly to the institutional landscape of the Classical era. Fifth Dynasty of Egypt is a dynasty in Africa, established in 2497 BCE. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 52 language editions of Wikipedia.
